items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions interviewing James Cotton; the interviewee (Mose Allison) does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with James Cotton.

ctx.x: I was just interviewing James Cotton, the harmonica player, and he said that when he was 6 years old, around 1940, he’d hear it on the radio, and he memorized Sonny Boy Williamson...
